subtitleNullable: Sri Lanka Used Car Market Dataset: Insights from Ikman.lk & Riyasewana.lk
descriptionNullable:
This dataset contains scraped car listings from [ikman.lk](www.ikman.lk) and [Riyasewana.com](https://riyasewana.com/), two of the most popular online vehicle marketplaces in Sri Lanka. The data has been preprocessed to ensure consistency, making it useful for price prediction, trend analysis, and market research.

Brand  -  The manufacturer of the vehicle (e.g., Toyota, Honda, Nissan).
Model - The specific model of the car (e.g., Corolla, Civic, X-Trail).
YOM - Year of Manufacture – the year the car was manufactured.
Engine (cc) - Engine capacity in cubic centimeters (cc), indicating engine size.
Gear - The type of transmission: Automatic or Manual.
Fuel Type - The type of fuel used by the car (e.g., Petrol, Diesel, Hybrid, Electric).
Millage (KM) - The total distance the car has traveled in kilometers.
Town - The location where the car is being sold (e.g., Colombo, Kandy, Galle).
Date - The date the listing was posted on the website.
Leasing - Indicates whether leasing options are available for the vehicle (Yes/No).
Condition - The overall condition of the car (e.g., Used, Reconditioned, Brand New).

AIR CONDITION	  Indicates if the car has air conditioning (Available / Not-Available).
POWER STEERING	  Indicates if the car has power steering (Available / Not-Available).
POWER MIRROR	  Indicates if the car has power mirrors (Available / Not-Available).
POWER WINDOW	  Indicates if the car has power windows (Available / Not-Available).

Price	The listed selling price of the car in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR).
subtitle: Sri Lanka Used Car Market Dataset: Insights from Ikman.lk & Riyasewana.lk
